coverage.candidate: section1 shifted reflected-copy offsets and fixed-word deficit
coverage.external_obligations: Construct the tagged occurrences and blocking-functional witnesses; prove reflected brackets preserve unblocked status, symmetry and fixed-word evenness; establish the descending count recursion and domination.

coverage.candidate: section2 phase-specific parity, adjacent sorted pairs and pair removal
coverage.external_obligations: Construct a fixed-point-free involution on phase-labelled occurrences; prove its phase preservation, exact count preservation under sorting, antitone exit order and entry order. Prove reflection-fixed profiles and existence of both geometric axes. The Lean theorem assumes these interfaces explicitly; it does not create staircase paths or certify their symmetry.

coverage.candidate: section5 first-success threshold, odd-core cardinality and surplus record
coverage.external_obligations: Prove the endpoint threshold bound, actual distinct occurrence set and identical-alignment bound. Convert cardinality to the sharp/wide bands, actual records, connected pairs and admissible source geometric operations. The k=1 geometry remains outside Lean.
Prove the half-Euler lemma, connectedness, construction cost, required-word coverage, suffix invariant and complexity. The scalar theorem is conditional on all these graph/count facts.

provenance.mathematics: New Lean code written for the frozen r37 candidate. Source truth convention retained. Pinned mathlib Finset.card_bij, filter-card partition and erase-card lemmas read locally; Nat.find and order/arithmetic tactics used. No candidate proof assumed as an axiom.

rebuild: python3 -I rebuild.py --output <new directory outside this package>; optional --cache and --lean allow explicit local installations. No network access or cache mutation is performed.
identity: verify.py --anchor requires the externally supplied manifest SHA256. It checks byte identity only, not mathematics or acceptance.
